Package com.smu.mtc.mtcbean.appendonly

Interface MTC_AppendOnly_Data_Dao

All Superinterfaces:
MTC_Data_Dao<MTC_AppendOnly_Node_Record,MTC_AppendOnly_Index>
All Known Implementing Classes:
MTC_Data_Dao_MySQL, MTC_Data_Dao_SQLite
public interface MTC_AppendOnly_Data_Dao extends MTC_Data_Dao<MTC_AppendOnly_Node_Record,MTC_AppendOnly_Index>
Persistence contract that a database adapter must implement for MTC_Service_AppendOnly.

This interface includes every common operation inherited from MTC_Data_Dao and adds updateNodes(ArrayList) for expiring superseded dynamic nodes. The supplied MTC_Data_Dao_SQLite and MTC_Data_Dao_MySQL classes are reference implementations.

The append-only service does not require MTC_Data_Dao.getCertsByTimestamp(long) during normal operation. An adapter may implement that inherited method by throwing UnsupportedOperationException. See the Javadoc overview's Integrating a Different Database section for the full adapter contract.
